name: MCP
maintainer: Linux Foundation (Anthropic OpenAI Google Microsoft AWS)
description: Standardized communication interface for agents to access external tools data services and contextual repositories. Client-server design with schema consistency access control and auditability.
use_case: Agent-to-tool communication: filesystems databases APIs internal tools. Stateless and stateful session support.
blocks_relation: Blocks agents can use MCP to connect to external tools and data sources. ctx.taskClient enables agent-to-tool calls.

name: A2A
description: Standardized peer communication protocol for independent AI agents to discover each other delegate tasks and coordinate without central orchestrator. Supports negotiation and structured metadata.
use_case: Agent-to-agent communication: subtask delegation result sharing diagnostic information telemetry broadcast across distributed ecosystems.
blocks_relation: Blocks platform supports agent-to-agent communication via ctx.taskClient. A2A is the emerging standard for cross-agent interoperability.

name: ScaleMCP
description: Dynamic and auto-synchronizing MCP tool inventory across agents. Extends MCP with automatic tool discovery and synchronization.
use_case: Large-scale deployments where tool catalogs change frequently and agents need up-to-date tool access without manual configuration.
blocks_relation: Relevant for Blocks agents managing large tool ecosystems or calling multiple external services.

name: AgentMaster
description: Multi-agent conversational framework combining A2A and MCP protocols for multimodal information retrieval and analysis.
use_case: Complex multi-modal workflows requiring both tool access (MCP) and peer coordination (A2A) in a single framework.
blocks_relation: Pattern that Blocks streaming agents could adopt for advanced multi-modal multi-agent orchestration.

name: OpenTelemetry
description: Distributed tracing and observability standard. Most agent frameworks emit OpenTelemetry-based traces for debugging and monitoring.
use_case: Production observability: tracking agent decisions tool calls latency errors across distributed agent systems.
blocks_relation: Blocks agents can integrate OpenTelemetry for production monitoring and debugging of streaming and request tasks.
